verdict.rationale: AFK describes AI-driven processes built as directed graphs of steps, but nothing in the evidence documents a public API for creating, updating, or activating workflows. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. The axis applies to a workflow-automation product, so the lack of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API
